svg.text: Flow 04 Counter payment, confirmation and cancelling
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• Staff confirm first and collect the money after: confirming checks and deducts the stock, so a shortage is found
before any money changes hands. Marking paid, deducting and confirming happen in one database transaction; a
shortage rolls all of it back.
• PARTIAL: the message asks staff to change the order with the customer, but no screen edits an existing order
(the API has endpoints to change or remove order items, unused by the web app). In practice the order is
